welcome.title: Welcome to Engineering Tools
welcome.body: Cable sizing, power networks and lightning risk, all in one place. Your work is saved on this device automatically.

privacy.title: Private by design
privacy.body: Nothing is uploaded. Every calculation runs in your browser and keeps working without an internet connection.
privacy.offlineNow: You are offline — still fully working

keys.title: Move fast with the keyboard
keys.body: Press a number to jump straight to a tool, or ? to see every shortcut.

go.title: You're all set
go.body: Pick a tool from the home page and start calculating. You can install the app from the footer any time.

home.headline: Electrical design, in the browser
home.lede: Size cables, plan capacity, draw single-line diagrams, and assess lightning risk. Projects stay on this device.
home.noRecentBody: Open a tool and start calculating. Autosave keeps work locally.
